title: Investigation of a 3 oz Water Protocol on Patients With Tracheostomies
official: Investigation of a 3 oz Water Protocol on Patients With Tracheostomies
summary: Examining the validity of a novel 3 oz protocol in patients with tracheostomies as compared to the gold standard of instrumental swallow assessments (Flexible Endoscopic Evaluation of the Swallow or Modified Barium Swallow Study).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has a tracheostomy
* Able to remain alert for testing
* Not on a modified diet for pre-existing dysphagia
* No head of bed restrictions
* Not NPO by physician for any reason other than possible dysphagia
* At least 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not have a tracheostomy
* Unable to remain alert for testing
* On a modified diet due to pre-existing dysphagia
* Head of bed restrictions for greater than or equal to 30 degrees
* NPO by physician for reasons other than possible dysphagia
* Less than 18 years old
sponsor: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
